items.title: Daman Rangoola, Lakers Expert, Does Candid Lakers Talk
items.body_excerpt: It’s Daman Rangoola, our Lakers Guy from Stratechery . And it’s a great podcast (in my humble opinion) on the aftermath of this shocking Lakers sale . Topics! Include! Did Mark “Timothy Ratliff” Walter buy the Lakers knowing he was in trouble? Bob Iger’s ominous “if things…
